periods.time: One year before Ikki's repeated first year at Hagun

name.zh: 一辉挑战折木有里的入学考试
name.en: Ikki Challenges Yuri Oreki in the Entrance Exam

periods.summary: Ikki proves his worth for Hagun admission by defeating examiner Yuri Oreki in a formal duel during the entrance exam.
periods.cause: Ikki's magic rank is too low for Hagun's normal admission standards, so he demands a combat test to break the standard and prove his value.
periods.process: Oreki accepts after seeing his resolve and strength assessment. She uses Violet Pain to share her illnesses and battle wounds with everyone in range. Ikki copies and evolves her saber style, endures shared injuries, activates Ittou Shura, uses Shinkirou to draw her counter, and finally steals her saber barehanded to land the decisive strike.
periods.outcome: Oreki declares Ikki admitted but warns that his self-destructive strength may ruin him. Ikki refuses to abandon the knight path, and a year later she tells him to prove her fears wrong with his weakest strength.
casualties: other examinees and guards are incapacitated by Violet Pain
Oreki loses the duel under fantasy-form damage
Ikki suffers severe shared pain and Ittou Shura strain
periods.significance: Provides Ikki's Hagun origin, early demonstration of Blade Steal and Ittou Shura, and his first bond with Oreki.
